The official project display name is exactly "Library of the Citadel" — a distinct project from Atom-KB's separate Library; neither mirrors, syncs, nor supersedes the other.
tagline: A visual hall for world knowledge.

citadel.label: Cyber Citadel
citadel.note: Citadel backlink is unset by default. Set citadel.url (or LIBRARY_CITADEL_URL) once the owner provisions the address; while it is empty the build renders a disabled placeholder instead of inventing a destination.

buildNotice: Mixed build. Six records are sourced: their cooking facts are summarized in this project's own words from the pages they cite and checked against them. Seven are original practical notes in the Quick Air-Fryer section, written here and citing nothing. Three are illustrative fixtures that demonstrate the content contract. None of it has been cooked or tested here, none has had a professional food-safety review, and no record is publication-ready.
footerNote: Library of the Citadel — an independent static Library framework, distinct from Atom-KB's separate Library. No backend, no tracking, no external asset requests.
